parameters.name: AbsolutePath
parameters.description: The absolute path of the directory. Specify `/` to browse the root directory of the backup.

parameters.name: Edition
parameters.description:
The Cloud Backup edition. Valid values:

- **STANDARD**: Standard Edition. This is the default value.

- **BASIC**: Basic Edition. Only ECS file backup is supported in Basic Edition.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of results to return per request.

Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is required to retrieve the next page of results. If this parameter is not specified, the first page of results is returned.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: Deprecated. Use MaxResults and NextToken for pagination instead.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Deprecated. Use MaxResults and NextToken for pagination instead.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The hash value of the directory. If this parameter is not specified, the root directory of the backup is browsed.

parameters.name: SnapshotHash
parameters.description: The hash value of the backup snapshot.

parameters.name: StorageClass
parameters.description:
The storage class of the backup data. Valid values:

- **STANDARD**: Standard.

- **ARCHIVE**: Archive.
